concerns.text: FR-005 specifies the linear regression baseline uses 'hand-crafted descriptors such as surface area and pore volume'. 'Such as' leaves the descriptor set open-ended, so an implementer cannot know when the baseline is correctly built and a reviewer cannot compare two runs. Enumerate the exact descriptor list (or state it will be fixed and documented in the plan) so the baseline is deterministically checkable.

FR-002 requires 'distance-based neighbors' edges but gives no cutoff or rule for the neighbor edge type (the {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} nm sweep in FR-007 applies only to non-covalent cross-contacts). Without a stated cutoff or a pointer to where it will be fixed, the graph construction is not verifiable against a reference.

SC-005 says wall-clock time is 'measured against a predefined time limit' without naming the limit in the SC itself. FR-004 states ≤ 4 hours; SC-005 should reference that value (or the constitution's Principle VII limit) so pass/fail is decidable from the SC alone.

'outputs all valid gas-MOF pairs found in the source data (up to a maximum of 500)' — 'valid' is undefined here. FR-001 says 'complete data'; the scenario should reference the filtering rule (e.g., non-null experimental permeability per the Edge Cases section) so the expected output set is reproducible.
